summary: End-to-end test of Fahrschule Safe Ride (FastAPI + React CMS). All 16 backend pytest cases pass (health, public content/testimonials/gallery, contact submit + 422 validation, JWT login/me/wrong-password, admin CRUD for content/testimonials/gallery/submissions, auth gating). Frontend public site renders hero+nav+marquee+services+fleet+pricing+gallery(6)+reviews(6)+contact; language switcher toggles DE/EN hero; contact form submits successfully and clears. Admin login works; all 4 sidebar tabs (content/testimonials/gallery/submissions) navigate correctly; content editor save persists to public site (hero.title_de) and revert works; testimonial add and gallery add succeed and items appear in lists; submitted contact appears in admin submissions tab. No critical issues found.

issues: Nav text contrast over hero image varies depending on hero photo brightness; consider an always-on dark gradient under sticky header for readability.

critical_code_review_comments: Delete actions in admin (Gallery, Testimonials, Submissions) use native window.confirm(); fine for an internal CMS but consider replacing with a shadcn AlertDialog for consistent UX and to allow automated tests to bypass it deterministically.

CORS allow_origins default is '*' combined with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject for credentialed requests; current implementation uses Bearer in localStorage so this works, but if cookies are ever enabled the wildcard must be replaced with explicit origins (server.py:587).
JWT_SECRET is read from env without a documented default; verify .env contains a strong value before production.
PUT /api/content accepts arbitrary Dict[str, Any] without Pydantic validation; consider a typed model to prevent admin from accidentally wiping schema-required keys.
server.py is ~600 lines combining models, seed, helpers and routes; splitting into routers/models/seed modules would improve maintainability when >700 lines.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_-prefixed entities (contact submission, testimonial, gallery item) created during testing were cleaned up via admin API at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 16 cases). Admin login is JWT Bearer via /api/auth/login. The admin delete buttons all trigger window.confirm('Wirklich löschen?')—register a page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) handler before clicking testimonial-delete-*, gallery-delete-*, or submission-delete in Playwright. Contact form testids: contact-first-name, contact-last-name, contact-email-input, contact-phone-input, contact-message, contact-submit. The site has not 'name' attributes on inputs—use data-testid only. Hero h1 concatenates title + highlight text into one element.
